اعتصبا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَبَا (iʕtaṣabā) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# اِعْتَصِبَا (iʕtaṣibā) /iʕ.ta.sˤi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
